subject: PO traceback & line reallocation for Verdant Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Aisha Quinn <aisha.quinn@verdantlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Verdant Labs Procurement <procure@verdantlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO traceback — onboarding invoice references provisional PO 889

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the onboarding call yesterday. We just pulled the first invoice that our accounting team received from Redwood and it only references a provisional PO token (889) rather than an official PO number we can match in our ERP. That blocks payment and vendor activation on our side.

Two immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the canonical PO number that maps to the provisional token 889?
- Can the line items be split out before we approve? Right now the invoice bundles compute credits and SRE support into a single line; our AP needs separate lines: "Compute (GPU hours)" and "Support (SRE + monitoring)".

Attached: Verdant_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed) — has expected monthly consumption and billing contact. We also need a spend cap confirmed (our security/compliance team requires a hard cap on pre-authorized spend).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — AP needs the PO number to move forward.

Regards,
Aisha Quinn
Head of Strategic Ops
Verdant Labs
attachments: Verdant_Onboarding_Form.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Quinn <aisha.quinn@verdantlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO traceback — onboarding invoice references provisional PO 889

Monica / Markus — looping you in.

Aisha — thanks for the note. We should be able to issue a canonical PO and re-run the invoice with the two-line split. Monica, can you open a finance issuance ticket and request a canonical PO that maps to provisional token 889? Please request the following:
- PO number assigned to Verdant Labs: canonical PO (format PO-YYYY-####)
- Spend cap: provisional request is $125,000 (covers two months of expected usage); please confirm whether finance needs a lower hard cap.
- Line split: compute (SKU: RD-GPU-HR) and support (SKU: RD-SUPPORT-MONTH).

Markus — tagging you because VAT/tax stamping might be needed for the PO PDF (Verdant indicated US entity but will share W-9 if needed).

Goal: have canonical PO and corrected invoice out in 48 business hours. Monica, please attach the PO_request form and ticket link when you open the request.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Issuance <finance-issuance@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Quinn <aisha.quinn@verdantlabs.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: PO issuance request: Verdant Labs (provisional token 889) — request FT-3348

Forwarding request to finance issuance — ticket FT-3348 created.

Summary: Verdant Labs onboarding invoice references provisional token 889. Requesting canonical PO + spend cap assignment and line-item split. Details below:
- Customer: Verdant Labs (US entity)
- Provisional token: 889 (internal onboarding token)
- Requested canonical PO: please generate PO-2027-6721 (or next available) and map to token 889
- Requested spend cap: $125,000 (customer agreed; noted in Verdant_Onboarding_Form.pdf)
- Line items: 1) Compute — SKU RD-GPU-HR — quantity estimate monthly 12k GPU-hours 2) Support — SKU RD-SUPPORT-MONTH — monthly 1 unit

Attachments: PO_request_RED-889.pdf (internal mapping + finance justification)

Finance, please also confirm whether we should include a tax block for W-9 or VAT. Markus — can you advise?

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
monica_patel@redwood.ai
attachments: PO_request_RED-889.pdf
From: Aisha Quinn <aisha.quinn@verdantlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Verdant Labs Procurement <procure@verdantlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO traceback — onboarding invoice references provisional PO 889

Thanks Marcus and Monica — that plan works for us. A few clarifications from Verdant AP: 
- Spend cap at $125,000 is acceptable; we still require an explicit "hard cap" field on the PO PDF to prevent auto-charge beyond that limit.
- Please ensure the invoice has two line rows as described; description for compute should include the billing period and GPU SKU mapping.
- AP also asked for a copy of Redwood's W-9 (attached to this thread if possible). We can expedite approval once the canonical PO is visible in our ERP.

We will sign the onboarding DocuSign once we receive the canonical PO updated in the invoice (link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123-verdant-onboard).

Appreciate the fast move on this.

—Aisha
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Quinn <aisha.quinn@verdantlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: PO-2027-6721 issued — Verdant Labs (mapping to token 889)

Aisha — confirmed. Finance issued canonical PO PO-2027-6721 and mapped it to provisional token 889. Attached is the PO-2027-6721.pdf which includes:
- Hard spend cap: $125,000 (explicit field on page 1)
- Line 1: Compute — RD-GPU-HR — billed monthly — description includes billing period and GPU SKU mapping
- Line 2: Support — RD-SUPPORT-MONTH — monthly subscription line
- Tax block: W-9 requested; Finance will attach W-9 in a follow-up (Markus to confirm).

Action items closed for now:
- Monica: please reissue corrected invoice referencing PO-2027-6721 and send to Verdant AP.
- Aisha: please confirm once PO appears in ERP and you sign the DocuSign.

Attachments: PO-2027-6721.pdf

Thanks everyone — ping me if anything else blocks collections.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
